narrative.details:
This is grim news, adventurer. To discover that our mortal enemies are merely pawns of a much greater threat is disheartening. There is no possible way that Lakeshire could survive an attack from both the Blackrock orcs and the black dragonflight. Should Lakeshire fall to this menace, Darkshire would fall next, and then what? Goldshire? Stormwind itself?

You must take this information to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind at once! If this does not merit the aid of Stormwind, nothing will and all is lost.
narrative.objectives:
Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.

Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.
